title: spec(connector-auth): ADR-0143 D2.1 `oauth2` and D2.2 `app-credential` auth variants, D7 retirement of `ConnectorOAuth2Schema`, and the per-dispatch credential handle on `ConnectorProviderContext` (spec slice S0 of #26702)
body:
domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4czVnUdQQCVKSW5J2uk

Filing gate: ③ ADR-directed slice. ADR-0143 (Accepted, PR #27231) § Implementation slices names a `domain:spec` slice for the D2 variants and D7; no card carried it. Sliced by #26702's card thread, plan 6524271601 (§3 S0, measured on `main` `d6c0a75f`). Filed by `domain:server` seat 1. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade (parent #26702 is p1, `security`).

Reach: every app builder whose flows must call an OAuth-only vendor (the hosted MCP servers of Salesforce, Slack, HubSpot, Atlassian, Notion, Asana; Feishu / DingTalk / WeCom app credentials). Today an authored `auth: { type: 'oauth2' }` is refused at parse, so none of them can be declared.
Reader who acts: `domain:spec` (`packages/spec`). The server slices S1 (#26702) and S2 wait on this card.

## What changes (ADR-0143 decides the shapes; key spelling is this slice's)

1. `packages/spec/src/shared/connector-auth.zod.ts` — `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema` gains:
   - **D2.1 `oauth2`**: `grant: 'authorization_code' | 'client_credentials'`; `authorizationUrl` (required for `authorization_code`), `tokenUrl`, `scopes`, optional resource / audience; `clientId` (not a secret); the client secret as a `credentialRef`, optional only for a public client; no PKCE switch (S256 always). Endpoints and `clientId` optional only for `provider: 'mcp'` on an http transport (dynamic registration).
   - **D2.2 `app-credential`**: `vendor: 'feishu' | 'dingtalk' | 'wecom'`, `appId`, the app secret as a `credentialRef`.
   - Closed enums, refused at publish with a located error; an inline secret refused on both (ADR-0143 Acceptance, line 5). Fix the header's "OAuth2 is intentionally absent" text.
   - ⛔ **No `signed` member.** D2.3: a scheme enters the enum with its signer and vectors, so `signed` lands with #26710.
2. **D7**: retire `ConnectorOAuth2Schema` from `ConnectorAuthConfigSchema` through an ADR-0087 entry; not redefined as a resolved shape.
3. `packages/spec/src/integration/connector-provider.ts` — move the per-dispatch handle interfaces (`ConnectorCredentialHandle`, `BorrowedConnectorCredential`, `BorrowedConnectorAuth`, `ConnectorCredentialRequest`, today in `packages/types/src/connector-credential-source.ts`) into spec as pure types, with `@objectstack/types` re-exporting them so the datasource borrow path (#27742) is unchanged; add an optional per-dispatch member to `ConnectorProviderContext` for the grant-bearing kinds. `ResolvedConnectorAuth` stays the four static kinds. (Why: the connector packages depend on `spec` only, and D7 says a provider receives a credential source "answered per dispatch, an interface".)
4. For the spec author to weigh: how a pre-registered client authenticates at the token endpoint (`client_secret_basic` vs `client_secret_post`) has no other place to be said; dynamic registration answers it per client.

Regenerated spec artifacts; `Metadata-protocol: added` plus the D7 retirement; contract review owed.

## Dedupe

Read the open titles for `oauth2`, `ConnectorInstanceAuthSchema`, `app-credential`, `ADR-0143`, connector auth: only the parents #26702 / #26710 and the ADR card #26768. **New.**

Links back: #26702 (S1 waits on this), #26710 (S3, `signed`), ADR-0143, #27293
